comment: Phase 3.6 call-configuration benchmark: letterbox step-down rung + audio batching + Opus silence suppression, measured on 30s of cam720 at call settings (320x240@24 q60 yuv420 motion+ikf+refresh, range coder, keyframe every 120, mono 16 kHz speech). Wire math per bench_bandwidth.py; batched rows group consecutive QOA chunks into type-0x03 datagrams of <=1180 B (8 chunks each for speech cadence). Letterbox = source pre-scaled to 256x192 and padded to 320x240 (the rung's actual encoder input); content-region SSIM vs the letterboxed source is 0.809 (identical to full-frame q60). Reproduce with bench_stream.c + the letterbox ffmpeg pipeline in BENCHMARKS.md.
